title: insolines-options
description: A utility mod for Turkish players featuring a custom ESC menu, F8 shortcut, Armor HUD, and built-in recipe viewer.
body:
Insolines Options

​Insolines Options is a utility mod specifically designed for the Turkish Minecraft community. It enhances the user interface and adds several quality-of-life features to improve your gameplay experience, especially on servers.

​🛠 Key Features:
​Custom Menu: Access the special features menu by pressing the "Özellikler" button in the ESC menu (available on servers) or by pressing the F8 key anywhere.

​Armor HUD: Track your armor status on your screen. You can customize its position using X and Y coordinates.

​Item Stats: View the durability of the item in your hand as a percentage.

​Item Resizer: Adjust the visual size of items for a better field of view.

​Optimization Settings: Includes small-scale optimization tweaks to help stabilize your FPS without changing the game's core feel.

​Anti-AFK: A simple toggle to prevent getting kicked from servers while you are away.

​Recipe Viewer (Crafter): A built-in guide that shows you exactly which materials (e.g., "3 tahta, 2 çubuk") are needed to craft items.

​🌍 Language & Regional Info:

​This mod is primarily developed for Turkish players. While some technical terms like "Optimize" or "Anti-AFK" are universal, most of the interface and crafting descriptions are in Turkish. This makes it the perfect companion for players who prefer their tools in their native language.

​🚀 Future Plans:

​Please note that this is an early version of the mod. I am actively working on it, and many more features and visual improvements will be added in future updates.
